customization.summary: Current Responses containers have files, 1/4/16/64 GB memory, expiry and network policy options; package/shell workflows require separately documented Hosted Shell. Inspected adapter uses fresh text-only Assistants gpt-4o Code Interpreter and requests none of these options.

features.notes: No custom base-image selector in hosted container create contract. Image media processing and skills are not container image customization.

Official Hosted Shell example pip-installs with org/request network allowlist. Separate Responses tool; no verified package installation in inspected Assistants Code Interpreter adapter or offline-wheel workflow.
Managed container create contract exposes no vCPU selector.
Current Responses Code Interpreter containers expose 1g default, 4g, 16g, 64g, fixed over container life. No memory setting requested by legacy adapter.
No selectable GPU in inspected hosted container create contract.

Shared container create contract exposes disabled or domain allowlist; Hosted Shell documents default-disabled egress plus admin org and request allowlists. Legacy adapter requests no policy; no network execution tested.

Files/state persist only in active reused container; expired/deleted data unrecoverable, no durable volume. Code Interpreter guide specifies 20-minute inactivity expiry; create API exposes expires_after without verified arbitrary range.
Responses auto context reuse or explicit container ID supported. Adapter creates new assistant/thread for each execute and does not exercise reuse.
Separate Hosted Shell Responses tool, not first-class execution in inspected Assistants code_interpreter-only call. No interactive TTY/sudo promised by Hosted Shell.
Current container upload/list/download APIs and file/image citations documented. Adapter flags true but uploads nothing and collector returns [].
Hosted Shell can run services, but no publicly exposed port/preview URL interface verified in inspected docs.
Hosted Code Interpreter backend not self-hostable; application-owned local shell executor is a different tool mode.
No container-runtime CMEK setting or key coverage verified. Adapter capability false is not an authoritative prohibition.

pricing.model: Current listed Hosted Shell/Code Interpreter container session fees plus separately billed selected-model tokens. Quoted gpt-4o token rates Standard; not Azure or a measured Assistants invoice.
pricing.limitations: Pricing page also says eligible sessions billed by minute with five-minute minimum; eligibility unresolved, so listed 20-minute units retained. GB is binary GiB. Inactivity expiry separate from billing unit. Legacy README $0.03/thread/day not authoritative. No old comparable dated billing evidence or price-increase claim; model versions/service tiers differ.

tested_configuration.requested: Fresh Assistants assistant/thread, default gpt-4o, code_interpreter only, text prompt and create_and_poll; no files, memory, container reuse, network policy, expiry or hosted shell.
tested_configuration.limitations: No new execution or provider-specific reports found. Success checks run completion, not tool invocation/source identity/runtime outcome; stdout is assistant prose. Positive native file flags not implemented. Empty artifact collector, no thread deletion and exception cleanup not guaranteed.
